verdict.rationale: A desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and screen access is a fair question for a consumer AI agent product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents such an app. The evidence covers a cloud-hosted agent reached through perplexity.ai/computer and an MCP server, plus a 'Portable Computer' local harness that needs an NVIDIA DGX Spark. Its webpage screenshots run in a cloud sandbox, not on the user's own screen, so they do not count here.
